_about: The pets' voices (12 Nov 2026, Jon: "Can we get voices reading for the pets", then "I need better voices. not robotic at all.", then his casting: "young voices like kids Male for irwin, female for granola. Sexy/sassy voice for Boo. rough man voice for salem. Old man voice for zimmy. Make them natural. Make them MP3 files"). For each pet: which natural voice reads it, its pace (1 is the voice's own; 1.1 a little faster, 0.9 a little slower) and its pitch (1 is the voice's own; above 1 is younger and smaller, about 1.2 for a child; below 1 is bigger and deeper). The voices belong to the voice model that is already on this Mac (Kokoro, through mlx-audio): free, nothing downloaded, nothing leaves the Mac. npm run pet-voices makes an MP3 for every line a pet can say, silently, into pet-voices/ (kept off the site until Jon says yes). To change a pet's voice, change it here and run it again: that pet's files are made again. saidAs: a few words spelled the way they sound, for the voice only; the card's words never change.
